title: Alajbegovic half-time withdrawal not a major concern for Juventus
snippet: Kerim Alajbegovic underwent medical examinations in Turin on Monday after coming off at half-time during...
body: TURIN, ITALY - OCTOBER 18: Kerim Alajbegovic of Juventus is challenged by Romano Floriani of S.S. Lazio during the Serie A match between Juventus and SS Lazio at Allianz Stadium on October 18, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Chris Ricco/Getty Images) Kerim Alajbegovic underwent medical examinations in Turin on Monday after coming off at half-time during Juventus’s 4-0 victory over Venezia on Sunday evening, and the initial reports indicate that there is no major injury concern for the young Bosnian talent. The 19-year-old was replaced by goalscorer Nick Woltemade at half-time of Juventus’s 4-0 win over Venezia on Sunday, their first game back since the November international break; Alajbegovic playing the full 90 minutes in both of Bosnia and Herzegovina’s Nations League matches. The youngster reported for tests at JMedical on Monday afternoon, and according to reports from Gianluca Di Marzio and various others, he is suffering from a slight muscular overload in his right leg. PERTH, AUSTRALIA – AUGUST 08: Kerim Alajbegovic of Juventus makes a run makes a during the match between Juventus and FC Internazionale at Optus Stadium on August 08, 2026 in Perth, Australia. (Photo by James Worsfold/Getty Images) His condition is set to be monitored day by day, but he is not expected to be ruled out for a significant period of time. Gianluca Di Marzio suggests that Luciano Spalletti could even have Alajbegovic back in time for Juventus’s upcoming Europa League fixture against Omonoia
summary_en: Tests on Alajbegovic after his half-time substitution suggest no serious problem.
